❓ Frequently asked questions

What is Naismith's rule?

Allow 12 minutes per kilometer plus 10 minutes for every 100 meters of ascent — the classic hillwalker's rule of thumb.

How accurate is the estimate?

It assumes reasonable fitness on decent paths. Bad weather, rough terrain, or heavy packs all add time.

What do the fitness options do?

Choose your fitness level to adjust the estimate by ±20%, and see both moving time and pace.
